regions.name: Río Ucayali
regions.quote: It was described from 'Río Ucayali, Mission Saraycu, Peru' and has since been recorded along the Solimões-Amazon mainstream as far as the rio Trombetas near Santarém including the lower reaches of most tributary systems within that range.
